description: This script manages commit lists for release notes, including creating, updating, categorizing, and exporting commit data, with functions for parsing commit info, categorization logic, and command-line interface.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: Data class representing a commit with fields like hash, category, topic, title, files changed, PR link, author, accepters, and optional merge target.

classes.name: CommitList
classes.description: Class managing a list of commits, including reading from disk, writing, categorization, filtering, updating, and generating markdown for release notes.

methods.name: create_new
methods.description: Creates a new commit list between two versions and saves it to a specified path.

methods.name: update_existing
methods.description: Updates an existing commit list to a new version.

methods.name: rerun_with_new_filters
methods.description: Re-categorizes commits in an existing list based on current filtering rules.

methods.name: get_hash_or_pr_url
methods.description: Returns commit hash or formatted PR link for a commit.

methods.name: to_markdown
methods.description: Generates markdown formatted release notes for a given category.

methods.name: get_markdown_header
methods.description: Provides the markdown header with instructions for release notes.
